name: United Electronics Company
summary: United Electronics Company engages in the wholesale and retail trade of electric appliances, electronic gadgets, computers and their spare parts and accessories, furniture, and office equipment and tools in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It operates in two segments, Sales and Services, and Consumer Finance. The company provides e-commerce, installation, and repair services for electronic products, computers, smartphones, and accessories, as well as extended warranties, gift cards, and installment sales; and maintenance and repair, third-party marketing, and consumer financing services.
